playstyle.identity: Akali is a high-mobility assassin who weaves in and out of fights with her shroud. She excels at diving backlines and escaping with her multiple dashes.
playstyle.howToPlay: Use passive-empowered autos between abilities for maximum damage. W shroud grants invisibility and energy restore. E marks targets for a second dash. R1 engages, R2 executes. Combo: R1 > E > Q > auto > E2 > Q > R2.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Akali spikes at level 6 with her execute ultimate. Hextech Rocketbelt adds another gap closer. She's strong in mid-game skirmishes and picks.

passive.name: Assassin's Mark
passive.summary: Abilities create a ring around enemies; crossing it empowers next auto.
passive.details: Damaging a champion with an ability creates a ring around them. Crossing the ring empowers Akali's next auto attack to deal bonus magic damage and restore energy.

abilities.name: Five Point Strike
abilities.summary: Throws kunai in a cone, slowing at max range.
abilities.details: Akali throws kunai in a cone, dealing magic damage. Enemies at maximum range are briefly slowed. At max rank, heals Akali if she's missing health.

abilities.name: Twilight Shroud
abilities.summary: Creates a smoke cloud that grants invisibility and restores energy.
abilities.details: Akali drops a smoke bomb, creating a shroud that expands. While inside, she's invisible and gains movement speed. Restores energy and extends duration when entering. Attacking briefly reveals her.

abilities.name: Shuriken Flip
abilities.summary: Backflip that throws a shuriken; recast to dash to marked target.
abilities.details: Akali flips backward, throwing a shuriken that damages and marks the first enemy hit. Recast to dash to the marked target, dealing damage again.

abilities.name: Perfect Execution
abilities.summary: Two-part ultimate: first dash stuns, second dash executes low health targets.
abilities.details: First cast: Akali dashes through an enemy champion, dealing damage and briefly stunning. Second cast: Dash in a direction, dealing damage that scales with missing health. Must wait briefly between casts.
